summary: 西班牙海滩遇上漏油，清得快与生态恢复得好并非一回事。研究者比较各种清理方法，也追问该用什么衡量恢复。
logic: 溢油抵达海岸之前能做什么
比较人工、机械与化学清理
按油品和岸滩环境选择处理方式
何时停手，怎样判断生态恢复
科研与政府决策面临的难题

paragraphs.brief: 里拉海滩残留的焦油
sentences: From the coast road, the beaches of Lira seem as they should be: yellow sand and blue sea.
从海岸公路望去，里拉的海滩还是人们熟悉的模样，黄沙映着蓝海。
But walk down to the tide’s edge and things change.
但走到潮水边，眼前便是另一番景象。
A whiff of petrol taints the sea spray.
迎面扑来的海浪水雾带着一股汽油味。
Water in rock pools has an oily sheen and boulders that should be wet and slippery have a tacky, tarry coating.
岩石间的潮池泛着油光，本应湿滑的巨石表面结了一层黏手的焦油。

After the oil-tanker Prestige spilt her cargo last November, these coves in Galicia, in northwest Spain, were a metre deep in a mixture of oil and sea water known to pollution specialists as ‘chocolate mousse’.
去年十一月威望号油轮泄漏原油后，西班牙西北部加利西亚的这些小海湾里，油和海水的混合物深达一米，污染专家称它为“巧克力慕斯”。
“There was no ocean, only oil,” says Pablo Garcia, manager of the Stolt Sea Farm, an aquaculture company in Lira, the area that became known as Ground Zero of the spill.
“眼前见不到海，只看得见油。”斯托尔特海洋养殖场经理巴勃罗·加西亚回忆。这家水产养殖企业位于里拉，当地后来被称为这场漏油事故的重灾区。
paragraphs.gist: 里拉海滩远看仍是黄沙碧海，走近才闻到汽油味、看到岩石上的焦油；威望号漏油曾让这里的小海湾积起一米深的油水混合物。

paragraphs.brief: 处理漏油时的多重取舍
sentences: The Prestige is the latest exhibit in the tanker hall of infamy.
在因漏油事故而臭名昭著的油轮名单上，又添了一艘威望号。
But while each new incident brings environmental destruction and financial loss, it also improves our understanding of how to deal with oil spills.
每起新事故都破坏环境、造成经济损失，但也让人们更了解该如何处理漏油。
This knowledge is hard-won — aggressive clean-ups have sometimes caused more damage than the oil.
这些经验来之不易，有时强力清理造成的破坏甚至超过油污本身。
Government priorities can also clash with those of scientists.
政府优先考虑的问题也可能与科学家的关注点冲突。
But such difficulties apart, a rough consensus on how to juggle the political, economic and ecological issues involved in clearing up oil spills has begun to emerge.
尽管困难重重，对于清污时如何兼顾政治、经济和生态因素，人们已开始形成初步共识。
paragraphs.gist: 每次漏油都要付出环境和经济代价，过度清理有时甚至比油污本身更具破坏力，这些教训逐渐促成了兼顾生态、经济与政治的处理共识。

paragraphs.brief: 风浪阻碍海上拦油
sentences: Oil is much less damaging at sea than on shore, so the best option is to suck and skim a slick off the water using specially equipped ships, or break it up with chemical dispersants.
浮油留在海上的危害比上岸小得多，因此最好用专用船只抽吸、撇取水面浮油，或用化学分散剂把油膜打散。
Booms can also be used to protect the coastline.
也可以用围油栏保护海岸线。
But the sea around the Prestige was too rough and much of the coast too exposed for booms to work, so there was little that could be done except watch the oil wash up.
但威望号周围风浪太大，许多海岸段又直接迎着风浪，围油栏根本不起作用，人们几乎只能眼看着油污被冲上岸。
paragraphs.gist: 油污上岸后危害更大，通常应在海上回收、分散或拦截，但事故海域风浪太大，沿岸又缺乏遮挡，只能眼看着油污上岸。

paragraphs.brief: 不干预可能留下长期油污
sentences: When oil arrives onshore, the question becomes how best to save affected plants and animals while minimizing damage to the surrounding ecosystem, and without running up a huge bill.
油污上岸后，难题是如何救护受影响的动植物，同时尽量少破坏周围生态，也控制好开支。
In large spills, leaving nature to do the job is a bad idea.
大规模漏油时，一味等待自然清除并不可取。
Even the oiliest shore will return to normal, but without human intervention this can take a long time.
即使污染最重的海岸也能恢复，但缺少人为干预，可能需要很久。
In 1974, the Metula spilled 50,000 tonnes of oil into the Strait of Magellan at the southern tip of South America.
1974 年，梅图拉号在南美洲南端的麦哲伦海峡泄漏了五万吨石油。
Because of the remoteness of the region and the rough seas, no clean-up was mounted, and patches of asphalt-like residue stain the rocks to this day.
由于当地偏远、海况恶劣，当时没有开展清理，岩石上至今仍留着一块块沥青状残渣。
“It looks like a cheap driveway,” says David Page, a chemist at Bowdoin College in Brunswick, Maine.
位于美国缅因州不伦瑞克的鲍登学院化学家戴维·佩奇形容：“看上去就像一条粗糙铺成的车道。”
paragraphs.gist: 大规模漏油虽能自然消退，却可能历时数十年，梅图拉号事故留下的沥青状残渣说明有时必须兼顾生态代价和经费，及时干预。

paragraphs.brief: 渔场和旅游区为何要清污
sentences: In the case of the Prestige, the volume of oil spilt and the wildlife, fishing and tourist value of the Galician coast demanded action.
威望号泄漏的油量，加上加利西亚海岸在野生动物保护、渔业与旅游业上的价值，使人们必须采取行动。
The first priority in a clean-up is to remove oil from the beaches as quickly as possible.
清理工作的首要任务是尽快从海滩上清除石油。
If washed back out to sea, or buried in the beach, oil can do more damage some other time or place.
留下的油如果被冲回海里或埋入沙中，可能在别处或日后再造成损害。
paragraphs.gist: 加利西亚海岸有渔业、野生动物和旅游资源，需要尽快移走大量油污，以免它被掩埋或冲回海中后再度造成损害。

paragraphs.brief: 人工铲油能保护干净地面
sentences: Cleaning beaches is ideally done manually.
理想情况下，应当靠人工清理海滩。
People with shovels are the only tools sensitive enough to remove the oil while protecting the ground beneath.
用铁锹的人能细致掌握分寸，清除油污的同时保护下面的地面，这是其他工具做不到的。
Only the human eye can distinguish patches of oil from the clean areas in between: on some of the Galician beaches, oil-coated rocks and apparently unaffected rocks sit side by side.
只有人的眼睛能分辨油斑和夹在油斑之间的干净区域。加利西亚有些海滩上，沾满油的石块就紧挨着看似没受污染的石块。
And people can work on isolated rocky shores where heavy machinery cannot go.
偏僻的岩岸即使重型机械进不去，人也能在那里作业。
paragraphs.gist: 人工铲油可避开干净的岩石、保护油层下方的地面，也能进入大型机器无法到达的偏僻岩岸。

paragraphs.brief: 万吨油污超过人力所及
sentences: But at Lira in early December, manual labour was having no effect.
但到十二月初，里拉的人工清理仍不见成效。
“We got the full load of a couple of tanks of the Prestige — 15,000 tonnes on two kilometres of coast,” says Garcia.
加西亚说：“相当于威望号上整整两个油舱的油都到了这里，两公里海岸上有一万五千吨。”
“You’d see guys working manually, and at the end of the day, the area occupied by the slick was the same.”
“你看人们全靠双手干活，一天下来，浮油覆盖的面积还是那么大。”
paragraphs.gist: 里拉短短两公里岸线上就堆了约一万五千吨油，人手忙碌一整天也无法缩小油污覆盖面积，人工清理在这里显得力不从心。

paragraphs.brief: 用地方知识选择清污方案
sentences: To decide what to do next, specialists combined their experience with local knowledge in an assessment process known as net environmental benefit analysis.
为决定下一步怎么办，专家把自身经验和当地知识结合起来，进行所谓的“净环境效益分析”。
Factors taken into account include environmental considerations, such as whether an oiled beach is home to a breeding colony of seals or seabirds.
评估要看环境因素，例如受污染的海滩是不是海豹或海鸟集体繁殖的地方。
Socioeconomic considerations also come into play: local people may rely on nearby shellfish beds, for example, or an affected beach could be a tourist destination.
还得考虑社会和经济因素，例如居民可能靠附近的贝类产区谋生，受污染的海滩也可能是旅游目的地。
And practical realities, such as how much a particular clean-up option will cost, and how easy it will be to implement, are also assessed.
评估还包括现实条件，例如某种办法要花多少钱、实施起来有多难。
paragraphs.gist: 选取下一步措施时，专家把经验与当地知识结合，衡量繁殖地保护、居民生计、旅游价值，以及各方案的成本和可行性。

paragraphs.brief: 高压热水对海岸的损伤
sentences: Every intensive clean-up option has its drawbacks.
强力清污办法各有弊端。

When high-pressure hot water was used to scrub the Alaskan shoreline oiled by the Exxon Valdez spill in 1989, beaches that got this treatment recovered more slowly than those that did not, although conditions seemed about equal after three years.
1989 年，人们用高压热水冲洗阿拉斯加受埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号漏油污染的海岸。接受冲洗的海滩比未冲洗的恢复得更慢，不过三年后两者状况似已大致相当。

This technique is now used less often, says Alan Mearns, a marine ecologist with the Hazardous Materials Response Division of the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) in Seattle, Washington.
在美国华盛顿州西雅图任职的美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）危险物质应急部门海洋生态学家艾伦·梅恩斯说，如今这种办法用得少了。
“We have a go-easy policy on using rigorous methods,” he says.
他说：“我们现在会慎用这些强力手段。”
“The coastguard understands that you don’t have to go in with all guns blazing.”
“海岸警卫队也明白，没必要一上来就把所有强硬手段都用上。”
In Spain, high-pressure water has so far been used only on man-made structures such as jetties and harbour walls.
在西班牙，高压水迄今只用在码头突堤和港墙等人工设施上。
paragraphs.gist: 阿拉斯加经高压热水冲洗的海滩起初恢复得反而较慢，这类教训让清理者趋于谨慎，西班牙当时只对码头等人工设施使用高压水。

paragraphs.brief: 强力清洁剂的生态代价
sentences: Chemical cleaners also do damage.
化学清洗剂同样会造成损害。

When the Torrey Canyon ran aground off the south coast of Cornwall, UK, in March 1967, oiled beaches were sprayed with 10,000 tonnes of powerful solvents and detergents, including industrial degreasers.
1967 年三月，托雷峡谷号在英国康沃尔南岸外搁浅，人们向受污染的海滩喷洒了一万吨强力溶剂和洗涤剂，其中包括工业脱脂剂。
The chemicals were more toxic than the oil: many seashore invertebrates died, and the nutrients in the dispersants caused an explosion of seaweed growth.
这些化学品比石油还毒，许多岸边无脊椎动物因此死亡；分散剂中的营养物质还导致海藻大量繁殖。
paragraphs.gist: 托雷峡谷号搁浅后，大量强力溶剂和清洁剂造成了二次损害，岸边无脊椎动物死亡，分散剂中的养分还使海藻猛增。

paragraphs.brief: 温和分散剂的适用局限
sentences: Dispersants are much milder now, but they can still be used inappropriately.
现在的分散剂温和得多，但用法仍可能不当。

Peter Dyrynda, a marine biologist at the University of Wales Swansea, UK, says that after the Sea Empress ran aground off the southwest coast of Wales in 1996, dispersants were used on some patches of oil but were not washed off.
英国斯旺西威尔士大学的海洋生物学家彼得·戴林达说，海上女皇号于 1996 年在威尔士西南海岸外搁浅，当时一些油斑喷了分散剂，随后却未冲洗掉。
The resulting mix was more toxic than either oil or dispersant alone, and killed animals that had survived until then.
形成的混合物比单独的原油或分散剂毒性更强，连之前幸存的动物也被毒死了。
Such problems, as well as the fact that dispersants are ineffective against thick oil, have prevented their use in Galicia.
这些问题，再加上分散剂对稠油无效，使得加利西亚没有使用分散剂。
paragraphs.gist: 较温和的分散剂若未冲净，仍会与油形成更有毒的混合物，又难以对付稠油，因此加利西亚没有采用这种方法。

paragraphs.brief: 让分解油污的细菌繁殖
sentences: A gentler option is bioremediation, which involves using fertilizer to speed the growth of naturally occurring oil-digesting bacteria.
一种较温和的办法是生物修复，即通过施肥促进当地能分解石油的细菌生长。
But this won’t work on every spill, says Richard Swannell, a bioremediation specialist with Momenta, a consultancy company near Oxford, UK, that works with the British government.
但理查德·斯旺内尔说，这种方法并不适用于每一次漏油事故。他是英国牛津附近咨询公司 Momenta 的生物修复专家，该公司与英国政府合作。
The oily shore must be sheltered, otherwise the sea will wash the oil and bacteria away.
受污染的岸段必须能避风浪，否则海水会把油和细菌一起冲走。
Oil buried in sediments can’t be digested.
埋在沉积物里的石油无法被细菌分解。
And if the natural bacterial growth is limited by temperature rather than by nutrients, the treatment will have no effect.
如果限制天然细菌生长的是温度而非养分，施肥就不起作用。
paragraphs.gist: 生物修复通过施肥促进天然降解油污的细菌生长，但只适用于有遮蔽、油未被掩埋且细菌生长受养分限制的海岸。

paragraphs.brief: 油质和时间限制生物修复
sentences: The oil must also be biodegradable: light crude oils of the type spilt by the Exxon Valdez are broken down easily, but heavier types contain compounds that microbes find indigestible.
漏油本身也要能被生物降解。埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号泄漏的那种轻质原油容易分解，较重的油则含有微生物无法分解的化合物。
Finally, sites must be secluded, so that they do not offend the senses of local people and tourists during the several months the bacteria need to work.
最后，岸段还得足够偏僻，免得细菌起作用所需的几个月里，油污的气味和景象一直影响居民和游客。
The remote Alaskan shores polluted by the Exxon Valdez fitted the bill, but many others do not.
埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号污染的阿拉斯加偏远海岸符合这些条件，许多其他岸段却不符合。
“For marine spills, bioremediation is a niche market,” Swannell concludes.
斯旺内尔总结道：“对海上漏油而言，生物修复只适合少数情况。”
Spanish researchers began bioremediation experiments on oiled beaches late last month, although the Prestige’s thick, poorly biodegradable oil might not respond well to the treatment.
西班牙研究人员上月底已在受污染的海滩开始生物修复试验，但是威望号泄漏的油黏稠且难以生物降解，这个办法可能效果不佳。
paragraphs.gist: 生物修复还要求原油本身可降解、场地偏僻且能等待数月，阿拉斯加的部分海岸适用，威望号泄漏的稠油却未必有效。

paragraphs.brief: 保护鱼场取水口的抉择
sentences: In Galicia, local people wanted heavy machinery to come in and remove large quantities of oil quickly.
在加利西亚，当地人希望重型机械迅速进入并清除大量石油。
But this has its own environmental costs.
但这有其自身的环境成本。
There were no tracks to the worst-affected beaches and building them would have harmed the surrounding landscape.
通往污染最严重海滩的道路原本不存在，修路会损害周围的景观。
“If you’ve got a site that no one visits, then it’s ideal to leave for natural clean-up.
“如果一个地方从来没人去，最好留给大自然自行清理。”

If it’s an area that people go to all the time you can’t do that, because people will be getting oil on them,” says Rob Self of Oil Spill Response, a company in Southampton that worked out of the command centre in La Coruña to advise the Spanish authorities on the clean-up operation.
“如果是人们常去的地方，就不能那样处理，否则油会沾到人身上。”罗布·塞尔夫说。他所在的溢油应急公司总部位于南安普敦，曾从拉科鲁尼亚指挥中心为西班牙当局的清理行动提供建议。
But at Lira, oil on the surface of the beaches was likely to be washed into the pipe that supplied water to Garcia’s fish farm.
但在里拉，海滩表面的石油很可能被冲进给加西亚养鱼场供水的管道。
In the end, the desire to protect the farm tipped the balance in favour of building tracks for bulldozers and earthmovers, which scooped up the chocolate mousse from the beach.
最终，保护养鱼场的需要在权衡中占了上风。人们为推土机和土方机械修出通道，用它们铲走海滩上被称作“巧克力慕斯”的油水混合物。
paragraphs.gist: 为重型机械修路本会破坏海岸景观，但里拉养鱼场的取水管面临进油风险，当地权衡后决定开路，动用机械铲除油水混合物。

paragraphs.brief: 重型机械对盐沼的破坏
sentences: Heavy machinery has not been used in all areas affected by the Prestige spill.
威望号的漏油波及多处，但并非所有受污染岸段都用了重型机械。
Saltmarshes and estuaries are such delicate terrain that almost any activity does more damage than the oil.
盐沼和河口的环境格外脆弱，几乎任何作业造成的伤害都可能超过石油本身。

After the Amoco Cadiz disaster in 1978, when nearly a quarter of a million tonnes of oil were spilt off the coast of Brittany, in northwest France, heavy equipment was sent into some polluted salt-marshes, where it scraped up the top half-metre of sediment.
1978 年阿莫科·卡迪兹号在法国西北部布列塔尼近海泄漏了近二十五万吨石油。重型设备开进部分受污染的盐沼，刮走了表层约半米厚的沉积物。
Twelve years later, these areas had still not recovered, whereas the oiled marshes that went uncleaned seemed in good shape.
十二年后，这些地方仍未恢复，而同样遭油污、却未清理的盐沼看起来状况良好。
paragraphs.gist: 盐沼和河口尤其经不起重型机械作业，法国一处被刮去半米沉积层的盐沼十二年后仍未恢复，未经清理的受污盐沼反而状况良好。

paragraphs.brief: 过度踩踏使油渗入底层
sentences: In Galicia, some marshy areas were placed completely off-limits, even to people, when it became clear that volunteers were cleaning with excessive gusto.
加利西亚一些沼泽区后来完全禁止进入，连志愿者也不能进去，因为人们发现他们清理得太卖力了。
“People were pushing the oil into the substrate, and that has more of an effect than if you just left it,” says Self.
塞尔夫说：“人们反而把油压进了底层，造成的影响比不动它还大。”
“In the end we had to close the site.”
“最后我们只好把现场封闭起来。”
paragraphs.gist: 加利西亚的志愿者因清理过猛把油压入底层，工作人员发现这比原样留下的影响更大，只得把部分沼泽完全封闭。

paragraphs.brief: 沿海滩手捡细小油团
sentences: Using a combination of manual labour and heavy machinery, the Prestige spill has now moved from what Self calls the emergency phase — high-profile, high-pressure — to a long-term, painstaking project.
经过人工和机械配合作业，威望号漏油的清理已从塞尔夫所说的高度受关注、压力巨大的应急阶段，转入长期而艰辛的工作。
Cleaning beaches, for example, is a Sisyphean task.
比如，清理海滩仿佛西西弗斯推石上山，费尽力气却总有活要重做。
At Carnota, one of the most heavily affected areas of Galicia, the high-water mark on the beach in February continues to be marked by a chain of thumbnail-sized oily gobbets.
二月，污染最重的地区之一卡诺塔的海滩上，高潮线仍被一串串拇指甲大小的油团勾勒出来。
Dozens of volunteers and soldiers work their way along six kilometres of sand on hands and knees, picking up the small lumps with what look like wallpaper scrapers.
几十名志愿者和士兵手脚并用，沿着六公里沙滩向前移动，用像墙纸刮刀一样的工具捡起小油块。
At other beaches nearby, people sift the sand and comb seaside plants by hand to remove the oil and stop it becoming buried.
在附近其他海滩，人们用手筛沙、梳理岸边植物，把油污清出，以免它埋入沙中。
paragraphs.gist: 紧急清除大面积油污后，工作转为费时费力的细部清理，卡诺塔的志愿者与士兵沿六公里海滩逐块捡起拇指甲大小的油团。

paragraphs.brief: 残油是否值得继续清理
sentences: Perhaps the most difficult decision, and one usually taken by local politicians, is when to stop.
最难的是决定何时停止，这项决定通常由地方官员作出。
As the coastline becomes cleaner, the clean-up starts to cost more for progressively less reward and more environmental damage.
海岸越干净，进一步清理的花费越高，换来的好处越小，造成的环境损害反倒越大。
On rocky shores, once the bulk of the oil is recovered, the decision often comes down to whether the beach is an eyesore.
在岩岸，大部分油被回收以后，是否继续清理常常取决于剩余油污是否碍眼。
Once workers have done all they can with shovels and pompoms — balls of plastic strips that soak up oil — stubborn patches still remain under rocks and in crevices.
工人用铁锹和吸油球（由吸油的塑料条扎成）尽力清理之后，岩石下面和缝隙里仍会残留顽固的油斑。
Moving oily boulders down the beach into the surf can accelerate the natural cleaning process, as can flushing — pumping sea water over the shore and sifting the oil out of the run-off.
将沾油的巨石移到较低的浪区，可以加快自然清洗。也可将海水抽到岸上冲洗，再从流走的水中滤出油污。
paragraphs.gist: 清理后期的收益递减，花费和生态代价却上升，地方决策者必须判断残油是否值得再用移动石块或海水冲洗等办法去除。

paragraphs.brief: 如何判断受污海岸已恢复
sentences: As the Prestige clean-up continues into spring and summer, researchers are starting to try to assess the spill’s effects.
威望号漏油的清理延续到春夏，研究人员也开始评估这次事故造成的影响。
Marine toxicologist Ricardo Beiras of the University of Vigo in Galicia hopes to produce data on damage to local fisheries on which compensation claims can be based.
加利西亚维戈大学的海洋毒理学家里卡多·贝拉斯希望取得当地渔业受损的数据，为索赔提供依据。
Researchers will also be called on to pronounce when the coast has recovered.
人们还将请研究人员判断海岸究竟何时算恢复了。
This doesn’t necessarily mean that no trace of oil remains — old, weathered oil is not very toxic, and oil locked in sediments may not harm organisms.
恢复并非一定要等到最后一丝油迹消失。老化、风化的石油毒性不强，封存在沉积物中的油也未必会伤害生物。
paragraphs.gist: 研究人员既要为渔业索赔量化损失，也要判断海岸何时恢复，因为仍有残油并不等同于它仍能伤害生物。

paragraphs.brief: 佩奇对孤立残油的判断
sentences: But the definition of recovery is disputed.
但各方对怎样才算生态恢复有分歧。
The owners of the Exxon Valdez are still fighting with Alaskans over whether the area hit by the spill is still suffering.
埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号的船东与阿拉斯加居民至今仍在争论，受漏油波及的地区是否还在遭受损害。
Page, whose funding comes partly from Exxon, thinks it isn’t.
部分研究经费来自埃克森公司的佩奇认为，已经没有持续损害了。
“With all spills there are places you can go back to and dig and find a deposit,” he says.
他说：“任何一次漏油过后，总能找到某个地方，挖一挖还会发现残留物。”
“The question is whether those isolated remnants are biologically relevant.
“问题是，这些零星残留如今对生物是否还有影响。”
And the answer is no, they’re not.”
“我的回答是没有。”
paragraphs.gist: 阿拉斯加漏油是否仍有影响存在争议，部分获埃克森资助的佩奇认为孤立残油即使还能找到，也已不再对生物产生实质影响。

paragraphs.brief: 赖斯对慢性生态伤害的担心
sentences: Others disagree.
其他人则不同意。
Stanley Rice of NOAA’s Alaska Fisheries Science Center in Auke Bay says the oil is still damaging animals that live and feed on the seashore, such as otters and salmon.
美国国家海洋和大气管理局阿拉斯加渔业科学中心（奥克湾）的斯坦利·赖斯认为，残油仍在伤害海獭和鲑鱼等在岸边栖息、觅食的动物。
“These damages are new and continuing from the remaining oil, and not just a slow recovery from the original hit,” says Rice.
赖斯说：“这些是残油正在造成的新损害，并不只是最初的冲击尚未慢慢恢复。”
To try to minimize such chronic effects, he advocates a swing towards more intensive cleaning.
为尽量降低这种长期影响，他主张重新采取更彻底的清污办法。
“I would push for a more aggressive clean-up, realizing that for the short term you are going to suffer more damage.”
“我会主张加大清理力度，同时也清楚短期内这样会造成更多破坏。”
paragraphs.gist: 赖斯持不同看法，他认为残油仍在持续伤害海獭和鲑鱼，因此即使短期会增加破坏，也值得加强清理以减少慢性影响。

paragraphs.brief: 仓促研究难以指导应急清污
sentences: Resolving issues such as these will require more research, but studies of spills are often only carried out in the fraught atmosphere after a disaster.
要解决这些分歧还需更多研究，可是溢油研究往往要等灾难发生后，才在气氛紧张时展开。
As a result, clean-up efforts are not as well informed or coordinated as they could be.
结果，清理行动获得的信息支持和各方协调都不如原本可以达到的水平。

“We don’t clean up spills as well as we should be able to,” says Ian White, managing director of the London-based International Tanker Owners Pollution Federation, which responds to spills around the world.
总部设在伦敦、在全球协助应对溢油的国际油轮船东污染联合会总经理伊恩·怀特说：“以我们具备的能力，本该把溢油清理得更好。”
“Spills take on a political significance that’s hard to control.”
“溢油事故往往带上难以控制的政治意味。”
paragraphs.gist: 许多溢油研究只在灾后的紧张和政治压力中仓促展开，使清理行动往往缺乏本可获得的科学指导和协调。

paragraphs.brief: 临时调集专家却缺乏统筹
sentences: Research tends to be improvised and opportunist, as local scientists drop what they were doing and start studying the pollution.
当地科学家放下手头工作，转去研究突然发生的污染，因此研究常是临时安排、见机开展的。
“In the early days of a major spill, things are terribly chaotic,” says Dyrynda.
戴林达说：“重大漏油发生后的头几天，现场极其混乱。”
“Scientific study is not a top priority.”
“科学研究很难成为头等要务。”
Like many others, Dyrynda had oil-pollution research thrust upon him when the Sea Empress ran aground close to where he works.
和许多同行一样，戴林达也是因海上女皇号在工作地点附近搁浅，才不得不研究油污染。
Scientists in northwest Spain are having the same experience, and once again the research is not running smoothly.
西班牙西北部的科学家也有同样的经历，这次研究同样进展不顺。
“There are different individual studies, but they’re not coordinated.
“各项研究各自为政，彼此没有协调。”
People are diverting resources from other projects,” says Beiras.
贝拉斯说：“大家还得从其他项目调拨资源。”
paragraphs.gist: 科学家常被迫放下原项目临时研究漏油，初期现场又以救急为先，西班牙各项研究因缺乏协调而分散了资源。

paragraphs.brief: 多次漏油仍未建立充分准备
sentences: But despite the gaps in our knowledge, scientists say that the major threat to the coast, should another spill occur, is not lack of research but of government preparedness.
科学家表示，尽管知识仍有空白，若再发生溢油，海岸面临的首要威胁是政府缺乏准备，而非研究不足。
There have been six major oil spills in Galicia.
加利西亚发生了六起重大漏油事件。
The region is also a hotbed of marine science, with four institutes in Vigo alone.
当地也是海洋科学研究重镇，单是维戈就有四家研究机构。
But such experience doesn’t guarantee that government officials will talk to local experts.
但这些经验并不能保证政府官员会向当地专家征询意见。
“There’s not a lack of knowledge, there’s a lack of communication,” says plankton ecologist Pablo Serret, of the University of Vigo.
维戈大学的浮游生物生态学家巴勃罗·塞雷特说：“缺少的不是知识，而是沟通。”
paragraphs.gist: 加利西亚虽经历过六次严重漏油、也聚集了多家海洋研究机构，科学家仍认为政府准备不足、没有与当地专家沟通才是下次事故的更大威胁。

paragraphs.brief: 西班牙专家抗议闭门决策
sentences: Many Spanish researchers accuse their government of ignoring scientific advice in their handling of the spill — particularly in its decision to tow the Prestige out to sea rather than into port — and of seeking to play down the incident’s severity.
许多西班牙研究人员指责政府在应对事故时忽视科学建议，尤其是将威望号拖向外海而非港口的决定，还试图淡化事故的严重程度。

At the end of January, the scientific community rejected the original plan for studying the clean-up and recovery, put together behind closed doors by the government’s National Research Council; the replacement was published only last week, four months after the spill.
一月底，科学界否决了政府国家研究委员会闭门拟定的清污与恢复研究计划。替代方案直到上周才公布，距事故已四个月。
Just before Christmas, Galician researchers, worried that the government was giving Spanish researchers a bad name, put together a letter of protest.
就在圣诞节前，加利西亚的研究人员担心政府的做法损害西班牙科研界的声誉，便起草了抗议信。
They circulated it around the research community, and got 385 signatures in 24 hours.
他们将信在科研界传阅，二十四小时内收到了 385 人的签名。
paragraphs.gist: 西班牙研究人员批评政府拖船出海、淡化灾情，又闭门制定研究计划，替代方案迟到四个月，抗议信却在一天内征得三百八十五人签名。

paragraphs.brief: 科学建议能否进入政治决策
sentences: Research into clean-up methods may be coming together.
关于清污方法的研究可能正逐步取得共识。
But as the strength of feeling among Spanish researchers attests, good science is of limited use unless scientists have the backing of politicians.
不过，西班牙研究人员的强烈反应说明，没有政界支持，再好的科学研究也很难真正发挥作用。
Without that, the damage from oil spills risks going unchecked.
缺少这种支持，石油泄漏造成的损害便可能得不到遏制。
“We haven’t learnt from the past,” says Beiras.
贝拉斯说：“我们还没有吸取过去的教训。”
paragraphs.gist: 清污方法的研究虽渐有共识，贝拉斯等人仍担心，如果政治决策者不支持科学意见，过去事故的教训就难以阻止损害重演。

points: 西班牙海滩遇上漏油，清得快与生态恢复得好并非一回事。研究者比较各种清理方法，也追问该用什么衡量恢复。
油污抵达海岸 → 人手、机械与化学清洗 → 油品和生境影响选择 → 生态恢复如何衡量
clauses: Water in rock pools has an oily sheen and boulders … have a tacky, tarry coating.
“that should be wet and slippery”修饰前面的 sheen。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 sheen，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, these coves in Galicia, in northwest Spain, were a metre deep in a mixture of oil and sea water known to pollution specialists as ‘chocolate mousse’.
连接词 after 引出“After the oil-tanker Prestige spilt her cargo last November”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 after 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: As oil-spill specialists continue to tackle the Prestige slick, they are drawing on knowledge from decades of clean-up operations.
处理威望号浮油的专家正借鉴过去数十年的清污经验。
John Whitfield reports from Spain’s Galician coast.
约翰·惠特菲尔德从西班牙加利西亚海岸发回报道。
